lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: No. 7,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I have a quick question.
I'm busy.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: You're lying.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Come now, I won't bite.
How can I possibly trust you?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: You're awfully snippy today.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Anyways,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: how are you feeling lately?
My shoulder and hips are a bit stiff, but other than that, fine.
Even if there was something wrong, I wouldn't tell you.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I knew it.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: So that means there is something bothering you, isn't there?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: It would appear I'm left with no other choice.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I'll have to impart some of my special recovery methods upon you.
I reject any and all medical treatment.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Don't worry, no medication today.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I've actually gotten deep into ancient eastern medicine as of late,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: so I wanted to teach you

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: the acupressure points I found :)
That actually doesn't sound too bad.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: See?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: So, starting from your back,

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: press hard with your thumb on the back side where your belly button would be.
I might as well humor Ether and do as she says.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Do you feel anything? Feeling better?
I don't know about feeling better, but it does hurt a bit.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: If it hurts, then that means it's working.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Next up, we have both of your temples.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Press them hard at the same time.
I follow Ether's instructions and press both my temples.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: How's that?
It makes my head hurt.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: really?

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Apparently the temples aren't the right location, after all.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Thanks for being my test subject :)

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I've got a guest.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: Now I know not to have them press just any old place on their body.

lines.speaker: ether
lines.text: I'll be in touch.
Ether???
There is no reply.
